# 08 — Expose coverage gaps, stale evidence and under-documented surfaces

## Outcome
Make the system honest about what the agency does not know.

## Requirements
- Coverage matrix by surface × topic × geography × evidence freshness.
- Highlight stale, missing, conflicting and single-source claims.
- Track source health/fetch failures separately from “no evidence exists”.
- Add prioritised research gaps weighted by surface importance and commercial significance.
- China/regional evidence cannot be considered covered merely because global/US evidence exists.

## Real product proof required
Render a coverage-health view that visibly identifies at least five genuine gaps, including under-documented retrieval behaviour for DeepSeek and at least two regional/China surfaces. Produce a ranked next-research queue.
